name: Rigatoni Cacio e Pepe
blurb: Pecorino and cracked black pepper emulsified with starchy pasta water.
method: Toast the pepper in a wide pan for 30 seconds, add a ladle of pasta water.
Cook the pasta in minimal well-salted water until al dente.
Off the heat, toss the pasta with the pecorino and splashes of water to a creamy sauce.
Loosen as needed and serve at once.

name: Fettuccine Alfredo
blurb: Butter and Parmesan melted into pasta water for a glossy, cheesy coat.
method: Cook the pasta in well-salted water until al dente; save 2 mugs of water.
Melt the butter into a splash of pasta water in a wide pan.
Add the drained pasta and Parmesan, tossing hard with more water until glossy.
Season with pepper and nutmeg.

name: Penne alla Vodka
blurb: A silky tomato and cream sauce with a hit of vodka and chilli.
method: Fry the garlic and chilli in oil, add the purée and cook 2 minutes.
Add the vodka and let it bubble away, then stir in the cream.
Toss with the cooked penne, Parmesan and a little pasta water.
Finish with basil.

name: Garlic Prawn Linguine
blurb: Prawns, garlic, chilli, lemon and parsley — 15 minutes flat.
ingredients: 4 tbsp olive oil, handful of parsley
method: Cook the linguine until al dente.
Warm the oil, garlic and chilli, add the prawns and cook until pink.
Add the lemon zest and a splash of pasta water.
Toss the pasta through with the lemon juice and parsley.

name: Cajun Chicken Pasta
blurb: Spiced chicken and peppers in a creamy tomato-Parmesan sauce.
method: Toss the chicken in the Cajun seasoning and sear until browned.
Add the peppers and soften, then the passata and simmer 8 minutes.
Stir in the cream and Parmesan.
Toss with the cooked penne and a splash of pasta water.

name: Creamy Mushroom Tagliatelle
blurb: Golden-browned mushrooms, garlic, thyme, cream and Parmesan.
method: Fry the mushrooms in oil over high heat until deeply golden.
Add the garlic and thyme, then the wine and let it reduce.
Stir in the cream and Parmesan.
Toss with the pasta and pasta water; season with black pepper.

name: Tomato & Mascarpone Rigatoni
blurb: A quick tomato sauce enriched with a spoon of mascarpone.
method: Fry the garlic and purée, add the tomatoes and sugar and simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in the mascarpone until smooth.
Toss with the cooked rigatoni and pasta water.
Finish with basil and Parmesan.

name: Orecchiette with Broccoli & Anchovy
blurb: Soft broccoli, garlic, chilli and anchovy melted into the pasta.
method: Cook the pasta, adding the broccoli for the last 5 minutes until very soft.
Melt the anchovies with the garlic and chilli in the oil.
Drain the pasta and broccoli and toss through the anchovy oil, crushing some broccoli.
Loosen with pasta water and finish with Parmesan.

name: Baked Feta Pasta
blurb: A block of feta roasted with cherry tomatoes, then stirred into pasta.
method: Put the feta in the middle of a dish, surround with tomatoes, garlic, chilli and oil.
Bake at 200C fan for 30 minutes until the tomatoes burst and feta softens.
Cook the pasta.
Mash the feta and tomatoes together, then toss with the pasta and basil.

name: Pesto Chicken Gnocchi
blurb: Pan-crisped gnocchi with chicken, spinach and pesto.
method: Sear the chicken in a wide pan until golden and cooked; set aside.
Fry the gnocchi in the same pan until crisp and golden.
Return the chicken, add the spinach and let it wilt.
Off the heat, stir through the pesto (and cream) and a splash of water; top with Parmesan.

name: Sausage & Kale Orecchiette
blurb: Craggy fried sausage meat, garlic, chilli and kale on ear-shaped pasta.
ingredients: 1 tsp fennel seeds, 1/2 tsp chilli flakes
method: Fry the sausage meat hard until deeply browned and craggy.
Add the fennel, chilli and garlic, then the kale with a splash of water until wilted.
Toss with the cooked pasta and pasta water.
Finish with Parmesan.

name: Lemon & Ricotta Spaghetti
blurb: Ricotta loosened with pasta water, lemon zest, basil and Parmesan.
method: Cook the spaghetti until al dente; save a mug of water.
Beat the ricotta with the lemon zest, oil and a few tbsp pasta water.
Toss the pasta through with the lemon juice and Parmesan.
Finish with basil and black pepper.

name: Spring Carbonara with Peas
blurb: Classic egg-and-pecorino carbonara brightened with fresh peas.
method: Boil the pasta, adding the peas for the last 2 minutes.
Fry the pancetta until crisp.
Beat the eggs with the pecorino and lots of pepper.
Off the heat, toss the drained pasta and peas with the pancetta, then the egg mix and splashes of water to a glossy sauce.

name: 'Nduja Rigatoni
blurb: Spicy spreadable sausage melted into a rich tomato sauce.
method: Fry the garlic, add the 'nduja and let it melt into the oil.
Add the purée and tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes.
Toss with the cooked rigatoni, Parmesan and pasta water.
Finish with basil.

name: Tuna Arrabbiata
blurb: Fiery tomato and chilli sauce with good tinned tuna.
method: Fry the garlic and chilli in a little of the tuna oil.
Add the tomatoes and a pinch of salt and simmer 12 minutes.
Flake in the tuna and warm through.
Toss with the cooked penne and parsley.

name: Butternut & Sage Pasta
blurb: Roast squash blitzed into a silky sauce with brown butter and sage.
method: Roast the squash with oil at 200C fan for 30 minutes until soft.
Blitz with the garlic, nutmeg and enough pasta water to a smooth sauce.
Fry the sage in the butter until crisp and the butter smells nutty.
Toss the pasta with the squash sauce, then top with the sage butter and Parmesan.

name: Baked Spinach & Ricotta Shells
blurb: Giant pasta shells stuffed with spinach ricotta, baked in tomato sauce.
method: Cook the shells 2 minutes under and drain.
Mix the ricotta, spinach, egg, Parmesan and nutmeg; season.
Spread garlicky passata in a dish, stuff and arrange the shells, cover with more passata and the mozzarella.
Bake at 190C fan for 25-30 minutes until bubbling.

name: Chicken Pesto Pasta
blurb: Fusilli, griddled chicken, cherry tomatoes and stirred-through basil pesto.
method: Season and griddle the chicken, then rest and slice.
Cook the pasta; save a mug of water.
Toss the pasta with the pesto, tomatoes and a splash of water.
Fold through the chicken and rocket; top with Parmesan.

name: Stovetop Mac & Cheese
blurb: A quick, creamy no-bake mac and cheese for a weeknight.
method: Cook the macaroni.
Make a roux with butter and flour, whisk in the milk and simmer to a smooth sauce.
Off the heat stir in the cheese, mustard and nutmeg.
Fold in the pasta and loosen with a little milk; serve straight away.

name: Bucatini Puttanesca
blurb: Olives, capers, anchovy, garlic and chilli in a punchy tomato sauce.
method: Melt the anchovies with the garlic and chilli in olive oil.
Add the olives, capers and tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes.
Toss with the cooked bucatini and pasta water.
Finish with parsley.

name: Pasta Primavera
blurb: Spring vegetables — asparagus, peas, courgette — in a light lemony sauce.
method: Cook the pasta, adding the chopped vegetables for the last 3 minutes.
Warm the oil and garlic in a wide pan.
Toss the drained pasta and veg through with the lemon and a splash of pasta water.
Finish with Parmesan and mint.

name: Quick Beef Ragù Pappardelle
blurb: A fast weeknight ragù of beef mince, soffritto, wine and tomato.
ingredients: 1 onion, 1 carrot, 1 celery stick, finely diced
2 tbsp tomato purée, 400g tin chopped tomatoes
method: Soften the soffritto for 8 minutes, then brown the mince.
Add the purée, then the wine and let it reduce.
Add the tomatoes and a splash of water and simmer 25 minutes.
Toss with the pappardelle and pasta water; serve with Parmesan.

name: Chilli Crab Linguine
blurb: White and brown crab meat with garlic, chilli, lemon and parsley.
ingredients: 4 tbsp olive oil, handful of parsley
method: Cook the linguine until al dente.
Warm the oil, garlic and chilli, then stir in the brown crab meat and a splash of pasta water.
Toss the pasta through with the white crab, lemon and parsley.
Serve immediately with black pepper.
